series.name: Northbound (citybound)
series.evidence: Counter 148 replaced 104 after 11 days (104 ends 2022-05-20, 148 starts 2022-06-01) at the same level (May 2022 ~129/136, June 2022 131/141 per day). 81 (North) and 597 both have the stronger AM peak (AM/PM ratio ~0.9-1.3 against ~0.5-0.8 for the other direction). After reinstallation on 2025-11-11 the AM/PM ratios swapped (617 1.0-1.8, 597 0.4-0.9), so 617 carries this flow from then on.

series.name: Southbound
series.evidence: 82 (South) and pre-November-2025 617 both have the larger PM peak (AM/PM ~0.5-0.8); the labels swapped at the 2025-11-11 reinstallation, after which 597 has the PM-heavy profile. The counter change in May/June 2022 shows no level step.

series.name: Westbound (citybound)
series.evidence: 211 replaced 148 on 2022-01-22 (148 ended 01-18) at a comparable level (Jan 2022 weeks ~198/427 on 148 and 245/503 on 211) with the same West-low, PM-leaning profile. After the 2026-05-29..06-08 gap the directions swapped: 250 went from ~110 to ~225 per day with the East profile, and 252 from ~230 to ~115 with the West profile, while the total held (~350 before, ~340-390 after).

series.name: Eastbound
series.evidence: 78 and 252 share the East profile (about twice the West volume, with an 8:00 AM peak) across the January 2022 counter change at similar levels. The labels swapped at the 2026-06-09 reinstallation (AM/PM ratio 250 0.22-0.30 becomes 0.45-0.48, and 252 0.46 becomes 0.21-0.30).

summary: Hawthorne Canal (162) and High St Randwick (175) are tube-counter sites linked by counter 148, which ran at 175 in 2021 and at 162 from June 2022. The main fixes are direction-label swaps at reinstallation (162 on 2025-11-11, 175 on 2026-06-09), which the series handle; a morning-dead period at 162 in March 2022; partial days at outage boundaries; and restoring genuine rain-day lows at the flood-prone canal path that zero_outage removed. The tripling at 162 from mid-December 2025 shows no sign of a fault but has no neighbour support, so it is flagged uncertain.
